For dimension labels, use a magnified clean crop and bind each transcription to its actual label box, dimension line and adjacent extension endpoints in original pixels. Keep different chains separate. Use map_dimension_chain only after transcription. If arithmetic or the claimed endpoints conflict, recheck that local evidence once, then report unknown instead of inventing a missing segment.
